vibe_rationale: Long-running alternative healing festival with yoga, breathwork and sound journeys, a genuine local scene but expo-like with markets and healers.
fit_notes: Conscious, wellbeing-engaged adult audience in peak holiday season, so the health angle is strong, but alternative-healing framing may sit awkwardly beside an evidence-based brand. A workshop or breathwork session role is safer than a stall, and as an NSW event it can be activated directly.
